topic: Estimating task and feature development timeline
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on estimating the effort for a specific task (DEV-119). It was estimated that completion would take three working days, contingent upon resolving how sessions and unique users are segmented by frames. The scope includes translating the traffic dashboard to new views, which will be configured based on campaigns and already support frame filtering.

Regarding front-end development, someone suggested requesting more from the frontend team (Sasha), specifically needing a new control for hierarchical data structures, passing parameters via POST instead of GET, and handling asynchronous Excel file generation rather than client-side processing. Finally, confirmation was given that Dynamic Slot Duration would be ready in time for the release.
decisions: The task DEV-119 is estimated to take three working days.
action_items: Resolve session and unique user segmentation by frames.
Frontend team needs to implement a new control for hierarchical data, use POST parameters, and handle async Excel generation.
